Roman copper alloy coin, 15mm in diameter, 1.5mm thick and 1.57 grams in weight. The coin has a green patina and is in fair condition, the images are very clear but the outside edge is missing. Obverse shows right facing diademed bust, inscription reads [CONSTANSPF]AVG. Reverse shows phoenix on a globe (to celebrate 1100th anniversary of Rome) with inscription FEL[T]EMP[REPARATIO]. Mint mark is missing lower portion but may read WorM PorB S
